add-endnote-bold-italic.title: Add Endnote with Bold and Italic Formatting to PDF
add-endnote-bold-italic.description: Demonstrates how to insert an endnote into a PDF and apply bold and italic formatting using TextState settings.

add-footer-page-numbers-to-pdf.title: Add Footer Page Numbers to PDF
add-footer-page-numbers-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a footer with automatic page numbers on every page of an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PageNumberStamp.

add-footnote-with-image-to-pdf.title: Add Footnote with Image to PDF
add-footnote-with-image-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a footnote (Note) for a TextFragment, insert an image into the footnote's Paragraphs collection, and save the modified PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-invisible-tooltip-button-over-text.title: Add Invisible Tooltip Button Over Text in PDF
add-invisible-tooltip-button-over-text.description: Shows how to locate a specific text fragment in a PDF and overlay an invisible button field that displays a tooltip via JavaScript when the mouse enters the area.

add-multi-line-text-paragraph.title: Add Multi‑Line Text Paragraph to PDF Page
add-multi-line-text-paragraph.description: Demonstrates creating a TextParagraph, setting its rectangle and word‑wrap options, appending multiple lines, and inserting it into a PDF page using TextBuilder.

add-rotated-text-watermark-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Rotated Text Watermark to PDF Pages
add-rotated-text-watermark-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf's TextBuilder and TextFragment to place a rotated "CONFIDENTIAL" watermark on every page of a PDF document.

add-semi-transparent-text-watermark.title: Add Semi-Transparent Text Watermark to PDF Pages
add-semi-transparent-text-watermark.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a semi-transparent watermark text on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's TextState and WatermarkAnnotation.

add-styled-html-fragment-to-pdf-page.title: Add Styled HTML Fragment to PDF Page
add-styled-html-fragment-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to insert a styled HTML fragment into an existing PDF document using Aspose.Pdf's HtmlFragment and optional TextState for formatting.

add-table-to-footnote-in-pdf.title: Add Table To Footnote In Pdf

add-table-to-pdf-footnote.description: Demonstrates how to create a footnote for a text fragment and populate it with a table, then add the footnote to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-text-to-pdf-from-memory-stream.title: Add Text to PDF from Memory Stream
add-text-to-pdf-from-memory-stream.description: Shows how to load a PDF from a Stream, insert a text fragment on the first page, and write the updated PDF back to another Stream using Aspose.Pdf.

add-text-to-pdf-page-at-specific-coordin.title: Add Text to PDF Page at Specific Coordinates
add-text-to-pdf-page-at-specific-coordin.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a TextFragment, set its position using X/Y coordinates, and save the modified document.

add-text-with-font-settings-to-pdf.title: Add Text With Font Settings To Pdf

add-underlined-text-to-pdf.title: Add Underlined Text to PDF
add-underlined-text-to-pdf.description: Creates a PDF document, adds a page, and inserts a text fragment with underlining by setting TextState.Underline to true.

adjust-word-spacing-in-pdf.title: Adjust Word Spacing for Inserted Text in PDF
adjust-word-spacing-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load an existing PDF, create a TextFragment, set its WordSpacing property, and place it on a page using Aspose.Pdf.

append-disclaimer-to-first-pdf-page.title: Append Disclaimer Text to First PDF Page
append-disclaimer-to-first-pdf-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a formatted TextFragment, and add it to the end of the first page's paragraph collection as a disclaimer.

append-multiline-textfragment-line-break.title: Append Multiline Textfragment Line Break Info

apply-background-color-to-text.title: Apply Background Color to Text in PDF
apply-background-color-to-text.description: Demonstrates how to set a background color for a text fragment in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf by configuring the TextState.BackgroundColor property before adding the fragment to a page.

apply-opentype-font-to-textfragment.title: Apply OpenType Font to TextFragment in PDF
apply-opentype-font-to-textfragment.description: Demonstrates loading an OpenType (OTF) font, embedding it, and applying it to a TextFragment to create a styled PDF document.

batch-replace-keywords-in-pdf.title: Batch Replace Keywords in PDF Using a Configuration File

center-text-horizontally-in-pdf.title: Center Text Horizontally in PDF

convert-modified-pdf-to-byte-array.title: Convert Modified PDF to Byte Array

create-pdf-launch-action-open-external-f.title: Create PDF with Launch Action to Open External File

create-strikethrough-text-pdf.description: Shows how to apply strikeout formatting to a TextFragment by setting TextState.StrikeOut and adding the fragment to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

detect-manual-line-breaks-in-textfragmen.title: Detect Manual Line Breaks in TextFragment Content
detect-manual-line-breaks-in-textfragmen.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate through pages and TextFragment objects, split the fragment text into logical lines, and determine whether each line ends with a manual line‑break for custom layout handling.

embed-css-in-htmlfragment.title: Embed CSS in HtmlFragment to Style PDF Text
embed-css-in-htmlfragment.description: Demonstrates embedding CSS rules within an HtmlFragment to control font, color, and spacing, and adding the fragment to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

emulate-kerning-in-pdf-text.title: Emulate Kerning in PDF Text Using Aspose.Pdf

extract-email-addresses-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, search each page for email addresses using a regular expression, and print the matches together with their page numbers.

extract-page-word-count-to-csv.title: Extract Text from PDF Pages and Count Words to CSV
extract-page-word-count-to-csv.description: The example opens a PDF, extracts the text of each page using Aspose.Pdf, counts the words, and writes the page number and word count to a CSV file.

extract-pdf-text-sentences-per-page.title: Extract PDF Text and Save Each Sentence on Separate Pages

extract-text-from-pdf-to-utf8-file.title: Extract Text from PDF and Save as UTF-8 File
extract-text-from-pdf-to-utf8-file.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract all page text using a TextAbsorber, and write the concatenated result to a UTF‑8 encoded text file.

highlight-keyword-occurrences-pdf.title: Highlight Keyword Occurrences in PDF (Case‑Insensitive)

insert-hyperlink-into-pdf-text-segment.description: Shows how to create a clickable hyperlink by assigning a WebHyperlink to a TextSegment and adding it to a TextFragment in a PDF document.

insert-identical-text-on-all-pdf-pages.title: Insert Identical Text on All PDF Pages
insert-identical-text-on-all-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to add the same plain text to every page of a PDF by creating a TextFragment, setting its appearance, and adding it to each page's Paragraphs collection.

insert-rotated-text-second-page.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf's TextBuilder to add a rotated TextFragment to the second page of an existing PDF document.

insert-same-text-on-all-pdf-pages.title: Insert Same Text On All Pdf Pages

justify-text-in-pdf.title: Justify Text in PDF with TextFragment
justify-text-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, add a TextFragment, and set its TextState.HorizontalAlignment to Justify so the text spans the full page width.

left-align-text-pdf.title: Left Align Text in PDF using Aspose.Pdf
left-align-text-pdf.description: Shows how to create a PDF, add a TextFragment, and set its HorizontalAlignment to Left for left‑aligned text.

load-custom-ttf-font-and-apply-to-text.description: Shows how to retrieve a TrueType font from the Aspose.Pdf font repository, embed it, and assign it to a TextFragment's TextState for rendering in a PDF document.

load-custom-ttf-font-from-memory.title: Load Custom Ttf Font From Memory
